_comment: Traditional Chinese rendered privilege elevation as physical height. The pack shipped 海拔 (sea-level altitude), 高程 (topographic/survey elevation) and 埃斯泰倫 (a phonetic transliteration of nothing meaningful) for a privileged-access product where 'elevation' means temporarily raising an operator's rights. A Taiwanese operator reading the sidebar saw 'Direct Survey Height' where the product meant 'Direct Elevation'. The domain-correct term is 提升權限 (raise privileges), which this same pack already uses correctly in 取得提升代碼 and 已簽發提升代碼 -- so the fix aligns the outliers to the pack's own established wording rather than introducing a new translator's choice. AGENT DRAFTS: native review still required before the pack is called Tier-1 complete.
